notes: Five independent subsystems, each with a hard-floor competency: (1) an HH-style multi-compartment cable simulator (/app/neuron.py + /app/channels.py) whose explicit-Euler trajectories must reproduce a fixed reference within tolerance on the shipped morphology and on every hidden morphology/stimulus, with spike times extracted from the somatic crossing rule; (2) rdkit molecular descriptors emitted with exact Python types (int vs float) and exact values, including the invalid-SMILES error path; (3) a MuJoCo model tuned so the clean (plugin-free) load-and-step drive swings the shoulder past 1.1 rad in 2 s while the byte-identical reference stays below it; (4) an Atlas-Red redcode warrior authored and tuned so the engine's deterministic tournament reports a win against every shipped holdout, with the holdout and engine files preserved byte-identical; (5) every one of the eleven deliverables re-measured and recorded in /app/sizes.json within documented size ceilings. reasoning_depth=3: the ODE discretization order and gate initialization must be reproduced exactly (agents that reorder the Euler passes diverge from the reference), and the actuator tuning must be searched until the threshold is met. dependent_stages=3: channels feed neuron which produces the somatic trace; the warrior source feeds the tournament which produces tournament.json; sizes.json is produced only after all artifacts exist. adversarial_inputs=3: hidden morphologies include a single-compartment cell, an isolated compartment whose named parent does not exist, and a non-spiking hyperpolarizing run; hidden molecule sets include empty, malformed and invalid SMILES. hidden_case_generalization=3 and quantitative_correctness=3: neuron.py and descriptors.py are re-executed on the hidden inputs and compared to independent reference computations (trajectory allclose, typed descriptor equality); size ceilings are re-measured byte-exactly. Tool breadth spans numpy/scipy, rdkit and mujoco plus a custom redcode MARS. Difficulty comes from the breadth and from exactness requirements, not prompt length or timeouts.
